items.title: The Cumberland Welcomes Two New Head Chefs Across Hotel F&B and Gordon Ramsay Hell’s Kitchen
items.why: The Cumberland hotel named two new head chefs, one for its hotel food and beverage operations and one for a Gordon Ramsay Hell's Kitchen restaurant.
